title: Hussain Sayeen
body:
Ya hussain ya hussain (×2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah ast hussain

Deen panah ast hussain
Maa naukar maula saeen anjo(×2)
Haan karbal ware saeen anjo
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
Wallah tere ibne haider
Charche hai sakhawat ke ghar ghar

Man misli hai fitroos ke lab par
Ham par bhi mehez ek baar
<<MINI>>

Hussain saeen (×8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum murshid ho tum aaka ho
Ham mangte tum andaata ho
Ham adna hai tum aala ho
Ham maulayi tum maula ho
Tum karte nhi inkaar
<<MINI>>

Hussain saeen (×8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Allaho nabi ke pyaare ho
Zehra ke raaj dulare ho

Kudrat ka hasin shahkaar
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
Hai wird bari ajmeri ka
Kehna hai shams noorani ka

Hai tera khula darbaar

Sindh walo ki hai shaan yahi
Mehran ki hai pehchaan yahi
Har lab par hai elaan yahi
Apna toh hai imaan yahi
Hum apke ke hai hubdar
<<MINI>>
Karo apna karam sarkar
Hussain saeen (×8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kayo maula saeen manzoor dua
Mukhe bhi ghurayo karbobala
Karbala karbala (×2)
Tumse hai muallah karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain noori tajallah karbobala
Kaabe ka hai kaaba karbobala

Karte hai dua zawar
<<MINI>>

Hussain saeen (×8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaliq ki mohabbat mil jaye
Naukar ko ijazat mil jaye

Hum ko bhi shahadat mil jaye
Kehte the sabhi ansar
<<MINI>>

Hussain saeen (×8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ka lasha wawaila
Akbar gaya mara wawaila
Tum reh gaye tanha wawaila
Yeh sabr tha kaisa wawaila
Kehti hi rahi talwar
<<MINI>>
Karo apna karam sarkar
Hussain saeen (×8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jawad aur mesum ki hai sada
Hum tere bhikhari hai maula
Joh rizq bhi hai humko milta
Hain sadqa tere asghar ka
Hum tere hai namakhar
<<MINI>>
